validate_audio_path: validate that a file path points to a valid audio or video file using magic MIME detection
validate_image_path: validate that a file path points to a valid image file using magic MIME type detection
validate_video_path: validate that a file path points to a valid video file using magic MIME and heuristic detection
is_video_file: check if a file is a video by detecting MIME type or scanning for ISO media, Matroska, WebM, AVI, QuickTime, or MPEG indicators
validate_rgb_color: validate that an RGB color tuple has exactly 3 values each between 0 and 255
